name: crewmesh
description: CrewMesh — Race-proof team formation service for Hack4Hack Crew Hiring Challenge 2026 (PS1)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/api && npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@crewmesh/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@crewmesh/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test --workspace=@crewmesh/api && npm run test --workspace=@crewmesh/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test:integration --workspace=@crewmesh/api
scripts.test:race: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test:race --workspace=@crewmesh/api
scripts.test:sse: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test:sse --workspace=@crewmesh/api
scripts.test:suggestions: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test:suggestions --workspace=@crewmesh/api
scripts.test:scale: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test:scale --workspace=@crewmesh/api
scripts.test:hardening: npm run build --workspace=@crewmesh/shared && npm run test:hardening --workspace=@crewmesh/api
